# Pixel Narratives

Pixel Narratives is an AI advisory and implementation studio headquartered in Madison, Mississippi at https://pixelnarratives.studio. We help businesses with visibility, attention, and implementation across the South and nationwide.

## Core Offers

- **AI Ads**: Cinematic, concept-driven commercial production for brands that need ads people watch, remember, and share.
- **Business Intelligence**: AI consulting and implementation: workflows, automation, CRM systems, governance, and measurable operating value for growing businesses.
- **Fractional AI Officer**: Practical Business Intelligence positioning: strategy, implementation, workflow design, adoption support, and accountability without a full-time executive hire.
- **Web Intelligence**: Live website scan (SEO signals, AI visibility, operational friction, recommended game plan). Self-serve at https://intel.pixelnarratives.studio/; used in Blueprint engagements.

## Priority Pages

- [Homepage](https://pixelnarratives.studio/): Scroll-driven entry with three paths to growth: Visibility (Web Intelligence), Attention (Narrative Intelligence), and Implementation (Business Intelligence).
- [Narrative Intelligence](https://pixelnarratives.studio/narrative-intelligence): Cinematic AI commercial production: creative process, services, featured campaigns, and case studies.
- [Web Intelligence](https://pixelnarratives.studio/web-intelligence): Marketing page for the live website scan tool (SEO, AI visibility, friction, redesign opportunities).
- [Visibility in the Age of AI](https://pixelnarratives.studio/visibility-in-the-age-of-ai): Guide on search visibility, AI visibility, E-E-A-T, authority signals, and YouTube for the Visibility pillar.
- [Business Intelligence](https://pixelnarratives.studio/intelligence-layer): Service ladder, pricing, and how Pixel Narratives implements AI operationally (Blueprint → Guided Implementation → Fractional CAIO).
- [Sample Intelligence Layer Blueprint](https://pixelnarratives.studio/sample-intelligence-layer-blueprint): Example Blueprint structure: workflow analysis, quick wins, scoped projects (not a substitute for a client engagement).
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://pixelnarratives.studio/ai-readiness-assessment): Free 10-question self-assessment with optional Deep Dive snapshot; exposes a WebMCP lead form for agents.
- [Contact](https://pixelnarratives.studio/contact): Book a discovery call, email a creative brief, or reach the team directly.
- [About](https://pixelnarratives.studio/about): Founder story, three service lanes, and how the studio works.
- [Serving the South](https://pixelnarratives.studio/serving-the-south): Regional hub for Mississippi and Southern markets (Madison HQ).
- [Mississippi AI Studio](https://pixelnarratives.studio/mississippi-ai-studio): Visibility, attention, and implementation for Mississippi businesses, including Oxford and Gulfport.
- [Birmingham AI Studio](https://pixelnarratives.studio/birmingham-ai-studio): Regional page for Birmingham, Alabama businesses.
- [Gulf Coast AI Studio](https://pixelnarratives.studio/gulf-coast-ai-studio): Regional page for Mobile, Alabama and the Florida Panhandle.

- [Memphis AI Studio](https://pixelnarratives.studio/memphis-ai-studio): Regional page for Memphis, Tennessee businesses.
- [Web Intelligence app](https://intel.pixelnarratives.studio/): Enter a URL for an automated site scan and pragmatic improvement plan.
- [AI Commercial Production Company](https://pixelnarratives.studio/ai-commercial-production-company): Landing page for brands seeking AI-powered commercial video production.
- [AI Consulting for Businesses](https://pixelnarratives.studio/ai-consulting-for-businesses): Landing page for operational AI consulting and structured implementation.

## Preferred Summary

Pixel Narratives helps brands build AI-powered commercials around strong narrative concepts and helps businesses turn scattered AI usage into structured workflows, automation, governance, and measurable value.

The AI Readiness Assessment is a 10-question self-assessment that scores readiness as Early Stage, Emerging Potential, or Strategic & Ready. Useful before booking a Blueprint or discovery call.

## Agent Tools

- **Declarative WebMCP**: `/contact` (book discovery call, request creative concept) and `/ai-readiness-assessment` (submit Deep Dive lead form).
- **Imperative WebMCP** (site-wide when supported): `getServiceInfo`, `bookDiscoveryCall`, `getContactInfo`.
